message: P1 new assignment: harden self-agent_inbox to prevent accidental cross-agent Ready-to-Working activation. Existing observe_agent task-79b4fe20 was independently accepted and merged (protocol 3.63), but the self-inbox identity still comes from user-supplied agentId on both transport and command. Follow canonical HTML spec: independent actor/session binding, reject out-of-session agent_inbox before any Seen or ledger mutation; keep genuine self activation and read-only observe_agent. Research first-session bootstrap carefully; do not weaken or fake actor authority. Include adversarial A-observes-B tests and Release suites, submit frozen source for independent review. Do not deploy.
